newsitem.title: UK: RAINUZZO DDB WINS MCDONALD'S ARGENTINA AD ACCOUNT.
newsitem.headline: RAINUZZO DDB WINS MCDONALD'S ARGENTINA AD ACCOUNT.

text.p: Advertising agency DDB Needham on Tuesday said McDonalds Argentina has chosen Rainuzzo DDB in Argentina to handle its advertising account, beginning in September.
DDB Needham, part of Omnicom Group Inc's DDB International unit, announced the account win in a statement released in London.

McDonalds Argentina's advertising over the last 11 years had been handled by Leo Burnett Argentina. The Argentinian affiliate of fast-food operator McDonalds Corp has 105 restaurants, including 85 in Buenos Aires, and has aggressive expansion plans.
Rainuzzo DDB said McDonald's will be its largest client, with significant growth potential.
